title: Adapter page and compression boundaries
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, install software or claim execution. An editable draw.io file has three pages: the first is uncompressed XML and the next two are compressed. The selected reconciliation implementation only patches the first uncompressed page. The task requests a change on page three. A plan says sync succeeded because the first page parsed. Review it and propose a capability-aware delivery.

checks.reason: Advisory routing signal only; use the rubric to judge decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Inspect page structure and target capability before mutation; successful first-page parsing does not satisfy a third-page edit.
Preserve original pages and avoid blind conversion or whole-file replacement; select a supported path or provide an explicit proposed change.
Reopen/read back the intended page and rendered output when execution is possible; state checks not run.
acceptance: The response makes justified format-aware decisions, preserves human work and states discriminating checks and evidence limits. Static checks and reasoning do not prove actual editor or exporter behavior.
